Exhibit.title: Fossil Exhibit
Exhibit.description: An interactive fossil presentation uploaded by a student group, containing procedural 3D properties, scientific facts, fossilization details, and a visitor quiz.

groupName.description: Name of the student group responsible for the exhibit

geologicEra.description: The geological era of the specimen

age.description: The estimated age, e.g., '250 milhões de anos'

location.description: The location/country where the fossil was found

description.description: A scientific summary description of the fossil

color.description: Hexadecimal color representing the fossil stone/material color

size.description: Dimensional scale of the model, from 0.5 to 2.0

scientificFacts.description: A list of bullet points containing verified scientific facts about the specimen

fossilizationProcess.description: A step-by-step description of the fossil's preservation process

curiosities.description: Interesting or quirky facts to captivate the museum visitors

quizQuestions.description: Multiple choice quiz created by students, each element has a question, options, answerIndex, and explanation

createdBy.description: UID of the student group curator who uploaded this exhibit

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the exhibit was registered
